CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tb_engagement_enquiry` (
  `lt_id` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `full_name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(160) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `message` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lt_id`),
  KEY `idx_enquiry_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_enquiry_created_at` (`created_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tb_engagement_subscriber` (
  `lt_id` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `consented_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `unsubscribed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lt_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_subscriber_email` (`email`),
  KEY `idx_subscriber_token_hash` (`token_hash`),
  KEY `idx_subscriber_status` (`status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
